Plain_English_Description: Buys the stocks with the strongest 12-month price appreciation while skipping the most recent month to avoid short-term reversal noise.
Indicators_And_Formulae: Momentum12_1 = Close[t-21] / Close[t-252] - 1 (252 trading days ~ 12 months; 21 trading days ~ 1 month skipped).
Score_Combination: Single factor: AlphaScore = cross-sectional percentile rank of Momentum12_1 where percentile = (rank_average - 1) / (N - 1).
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight (1/N); static buy-and-hold; entry at next trading day's open after formation date; 0.1% transaction cost; max 20% single-stock weight.
Notes: Classic Jegadeesh-Titman style 12-1 momentum; the project's baseline strategy (src/research/momentum_baseline.py).

Plain_English_Description: Buys stocks with the strongest medium-term (6-month) price trend, skipping the latest month.
Indicators_And_Formulae: Momentum6_1 = Close[t-21] / Close[t-126] - 1 (126 trading days ~ 6 months).
Score_Combination: Single factor: AlphaScore = cross-sectional percentile rank of Momentum6_1.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Highest CAGR among all 15 models in the single-formation-date comparison.

Plain_English_Description: Buys stocks with the strongest short-term (3-month) price trend, skipping the latest month.
Indicators_And_Formulae: Momentum3_1 = Close[t-21] / Close[t-63] - 1 (63 trading days ~ 3 months).
Score_Combination: Single factor: AlphaScore = cross-sectional percentile rank of Momentum3_1.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Used as the default signal in the rebalancing/Markowitz strategy comparison (src/research/strategy_comparison.py). Highest average Sharpe across formation dates in the 2160-run experiment grid.

Plain_English_Description: Blends short-, medium-, and long-horizon momentum so a stock must be strong across several time frames.
Indicators_And_Formulae: Momentum12_1 = Close[t-21]/Close[t-252]-1; Momentum6_1 = Close[t-21]/Close[t-126]-1; Momentum3_1 = Close[t-21]/Close[t-63]-1.
Score_Combination: Each factor is percentile-ranked cross-sectionally, then AlphaScore = weighted average of percentiles (weights normalised by their sum, so equal 1/3 each).
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Diversifies away reliance on a single lookback window.

Plain_English_Description: Combines absolute momentum with outperformance relative to the universe benchmark.
Indicators_And_Formulae: Momentum12_1 = Close[t-21]/Close[t-252]-1; RS126 = (Close/Close[t-126]-1) - (BenchmarkIndex/BenchmarkIndex[t-126]-1) where BenchmarkIndex = cumulative product of (1 + equal-weighted mean daily return of all universe stocks).
Score_Combination: Percentile rank each factor, then equal-weighted average of the two percentiles.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Benchmark is a synthetic equal-weighted universe proxy because no Nifty index price series is stored locally.

Plain_English_Description: Combines 12-month momentum with how smooth and persistent the recent price trend has been.
Indicators_And_Formulae: Momentum12_1 as above; Trend126_TrendStrength = Slope * R2 from a rolling OLS regression of ln(Close) on a time index 0..125 (126-day window) where Slope = Cov(x,y)/Var(x) and R2 = Cov(x,y)^2/(Var(x)*Var(y)); computed with closed-form rolling sums.
Score_Combination: Percentile rank each factor, then equal-weighted average.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Produced identical results to composite_quantitative in the saved run, indicating both selected the same 10 stocks and gave the same weights on that formation date.

Plain_English_Description: Buys stocks that have most outperformed the (synthetic) market benchmark over about 6 months.
Indicators_And_Formulae: RS126 = (Close/Close[t-126] - 1) - (BenchmarkIndex/BenchmarkIndex[t-126] - 1); BenchmarkIndex = cumprod(1 + mean daily return across the universe).
Score_Combination: Single factor: percentile rank of RS126.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Features RS21/RS63/RS252 and their ratio forms are also computed in the feature panel but only RS126 is used by this model.

Plain_English_Description: Buys stocks in smooth, statistically strong uptrends over ~6 months.
Indicators_And_Formulae: Slope and R2 of the rolling OLS fit of ln(Close) against time over 126 trading days; TrendStrength = Slope * R2 (steep and well-fitting trends score highest).
Score_Combination: Single factor: percentile rank of Trend126_TrendStrength.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Trend windows 60/90/126/180 days were stress-tested in src/research/sensitivity.py; 126 days had the best average Sharpe.

Plain_English_Description: Combines trend smoothness, proximity to the 52-week high, and moving-average alignment to find well-established uptrends.
Indicators_And_Formulae: Trend126_TrendStrength = OLS Slope*R2 on ln(Close) (126d); CloseTo52WHigh = Close / max(High over prior 252 days, shifted 1 day); MAStructure = mean(MA20/MA50, MA50/MA200) where MAn = TA-Lib SMA over n days.
Score_Combination: Percentile rank each factor, then equal-weighted average of the three percentiles.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: One of the weaker CAGR performers in the saved comparison.

Plain_English_Description: Buys stocks trading closest to (or above) their prior 52-week high.
Indicators_And_Formulae: CloseTo52WHigh = Close / rolling_max(High, 252 days) where the rolling maximum is shifted by one day so the current bar is not used to confirm itself.
Score_Combination: Single factor: percentile rank of CloseTo52WHigh.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Weakest model by Sharpe and deepest drawdown in the saved comparison.

Plain_English_Description: Buys stocks whose close is furthest above their prior 252-day high, scaled by recent volatility.
Indicators_And_Formulae: BreakoutDistance252D = Close - rolling_max(High, 252 days, shifted 1 day); BreakoutDistance252D_ATR = BreakoutDistance252D / ATR14 where ATR14 = TA-Lib Average True Range over 14 days.
Score_Combination: Single factor: percentile rank of BreakoutDistance252D_ATR.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Breakout flags and distances for 20/55/126/252-day windows are computed; only the 252-day ATR-scaled distance is used here.

Plain_English_Description: Buys stocks with strong 6-month returns that are also trading on unusually high volume.
Indicators_And_Formulae: VolumeConfirmedMomentum = R126 * (Volume / VolMA60) where R126 = Close/Close[t-126]-1 and VolMA60 = 60-day rolling mean of Volume.
Score_Combination: Single factor: percentile rank of VolumeConfirmedMomentum.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Lower CAGR but one of the best Sharpe and smallest drawdowns in the single-formation comparison.

Plain_English_Description: Ranks stocks by 12-month momentum per unit of volatility, favouring steadier gainers.
Indicators_And_Formulae: RiskAdjMomentum = Momentum12_1 / Vol126; Vol126 = rolling std of daily returns over 126 days * sqrt(252) (annualised).
Score_Combination: Single derived factor: percentile rank of RiskAdjMomentum.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Derived on the fly from stored features in src/signals/composite.py.

Plain_English_Description: Blends momentum, relative strength, trend, moving-average structure, RSI, ADX, breakout distance, and volume-confirmed momentum into one score.
Features_Used: Momentum12_1; RS126; Trend126_TrendStrength; MAStructure; RSI14; ADX14; BreakoutDistance252D_ATR; VolumeConfirmedMomentum
Indicators_And_Formulae: Momentum12_1 = Close[t-21]/Close[t-252]-1; RS126 = stock 126d return minus benchmark 126d return; Trend126_TrendStrength = OLS Slope*R2 on ln(Close); MAStructure = mean(SMA20/SMA50, SMA50/SMA200); RSI14 = TA-Lib Relative Strength Index (14); ADX14 = TA-Lib Average Directional Index (14); BreakoutDistance252D_ATR = (Close - prior 252d high)/ATR14; VolumeConfirmedMomentum = R126*Volume/VolMA60.
Score_Combination: Percentile rank every factor, then equal-weighted average of the 8 percentiles.
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Highest Sharpe and smallest drawdown among all 15 models in the saved comparison, despite lower CAGR.

Plain_English_Description: Weighted blend of momentum, relative strength, trend, 52-week-high proximity, volume confirmation, risk-adjusted momentum and moving-average structure.
Features_Used: Momentum12_1; Momentum6_1; Momentum3_1; RS126; Trend126_TrendStrength; CloseTo52WHigh; VolumeConfirmedMomentum; RiskAdjMomentum; MAStructure
Indicators_And_Formulae: Same factor definitions as above: Momentum windows 252/126/63 days with 21-day skip; RS126 vs synthetic benchmark; OLS Slope*R2 trend (126d); Close/52W prior high; R126*Volume/VolMA60; Momentum12_1/Vol126; mean(SMA20/SMA50, SMA50/SMA200).
Factor_Weights: Momentum12_1=0.25; Momentum6_1=0.15; Momentum3_1=0.10; RS126=0.15; Trend126_TrendStrength=0.10; CloseTo52WHigh=0.10; VolumeConfirmedMomentum=0.05; RiskAdjMomentum=0.05; MAStructure=0.05 (sum=1.0)
Score_Combination: Percentile rank every factor, then AlphaScore = sum(percentile_i * weight_i / sum(weights)).
Selection_And_Execution: Top 10 by AlphaScore; equal weight; static buy-and-hold; next-day open entry; 0.1% cost; 20% max weight.
Notes: Used as the fixed alpha model in the weighting-method and correlation-threshold comparisons. Results matched momentum_trend exactly in the saved run.
